Identifiers and defaults

Source: vignettes/identifiers-defaults.Rmd
identifiers-defaults.Rmd

Equation identifiers select a taper implementation. Species identifiers select species scope and property records. Forest Service region, forest, and district fields are agency codes used by the source default lookup.

Stored equations 

## Inspect equations stored with the shipped tree list
assignments <- example_trees %>%
  distinct(spcd, species, model)
spcd species model
202 Douglas-fir F00FW2W202
263 western hemlock F03FW2W263 
## Check the stored species and equation assignments
check_taper_models(id = assignments$model, spcd = assignments$spcd)
#> [1] row     id      code    problem input  
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)

An empty diagnosis table means the assignment checks passed. An explicit model takes precedence over taper_map and automatic defaults.

Source defaults

nvel_default_equation() applies the pinned lookup to agency codes already present in the example inventory.

## Resolve equations for the shipped agency-code combinations
defaults <- example_trees_pnw %>%
  distinct(region, forest, district, spcd) %>%
  mutate(model = nvel_default_equation(region = region,
                                       forest = forest,
                                       district = district,
                                       spcd = spcd))
region forest district spcd model
6 12 0 202 F00FW2W202
6 12 0 263 F03FW2W263 
## Attach the resolved equations to inventory rows
trees <- example_trees_pnw %>%
  left_join(defaults, by = c('region', 'forest', 'district', 'spcd'))
tree species model
1 Douglas-fir F00FW2W202
2 Douglas-fir F00FW2W202
3 Douglas-fir F00FW2W202
4 Douglas-fir F00FW2W202
5 western hemlock F03FW2W263

nvel_from_fia_code() translates Forest Inventory and Analysis inventory equation codes into source identifiers. Its geosub and primary_top arguments participate in source substitutions.

Species and ecological codes 

## Resolve species records for the example tree list
species <- species_lookup(x = assignments$spcd, from = 'spcd')
spcd common scientific
202 Douglas-fir Pseudotsuga menziesii
263 western hemlock Tsuga heterophylla

species_reference stores names, wood density, and bark ratios. nsvb_division() returns county-predominant ecological codes from state and county codes. nsvb_division_xy() uses coordinates and packaged ecological boundaries for location-based assignment.

Registry record 

## Save the current equation registrations
manifest <- taper_manifest()

## Compare the saved record with the current registry
check_taper_manifest(manifest = manifest)
#> [1] id      problem
#> <0 rows> (or 0-length row.names)
id owner_package package_version generation
100FW2W202 merchandiser 0.4.0 3
100JB2W017 merchandiser 0.4.0 3115
100JB2W019 merchandiser 0.4.0 3116
100JB2W073 merchandiser 0.4.0 3117
100JB2W108 merchandiser 0.4.0 3118

The manifest records registered identifiers, owning packages, versions, and registration order. It excludes local coefficients and source identifiers resolved without explicit registration. Save fitted objects or coefficient vectors separately.
